A few things to know

Before
your moment.

Still have a question?
Let’s talk ↗

How do I book?

Choose a package and send a request through our booking page. We’ll get in touch to discuss your preferred date and finalise your session.

How much is required to secure my session?

We’ll confirm the payment required to secure your session when we reply to your booking request.

Can my family join my graduation shoot?

Grad Signature includes family portraits for up to 4 people. Grad Experience includes a family group of up to 6 people. An additional person beyond the package allowance is TT$75.

Can I bring a second outfit?

Yes. Grad Signature allows up to 2 looks, and Grad Experience allows up to 3. Grad Mini includes 1 look.

Can my friends join?

Grad Experience includes family and friend portraits. Tell us your group size when booking so we can confirm the arrangement and any additions. An additional graduate starts at TT$300.

Where are graduation sessions held?

Tell us your preferred location when booking. We’ll discuss a suitable setting and confirm the location with you.

Do you travel?

Sessions outside our standard service area may attract a travel fee. Share your proposed location and we’ll confirm the details before booking.

How long does editing take?

We’ll confirm the editing turnaround when we finalise your session. A 48-hour priority delivery add-on is available for TT$200.

How will I receive my photographs?

Your retouched, high-resolution photographs are delivered through a private online gallery. We’ll share your gallery link and access details with you.

Can I purchase additional photographs?

Yes. An additional professionally retouched image is TT$50, or choose 5 additional retouched images for TT$200.

Can I order prints?

Yes. Grad Signature includes one 6×4 print, and Grad Experience includes one 8×10 print. Additional prints are available; ask us about sizes and prices.
